<thought>Based on the mapped reaction provided, the two reactant fragments correspond to the chalcone fragment and the cyclic ketone fragment. Converting the atom‑mapped SMARTS to regular SMILES gives the chalcone as “C=CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1” and the cyclic ketone as “O[C]1C(C(C(C(C(C1O)=O)C)C)C)C”. Therefore the list of possible precursor combinations is a single pair containing these two SMILES strings.</thought>
<final_answer>[['C=CC(=O)C=Cc1ccccc1', 'O[C]1C(C(C(C(C(C1O)=O)C)C)C)C']]</final_answer>
